reason: Free budget apps already do this, and I can already see my bank transfers in my bank app. Paying 69 baht for the slip Shortcut only makes sense if setting it up is quick and it saves me real time, and a one-time setup with a video does not convince me that it will.
objection: Why would I pay after the trial when the free apps track spending too? I would have to set up an iPhone Shortcut and trust that OCR reads my slips correctly every time.
would_change_my_mind: A free app that does not do this, or proof that the Shortcut reads my K PLUS slips correctly with almost no setup, so it saves me real typing every month.
